scope: Additional shared-span alignment on frozen accepted exports. This is a local operation benchmark, not a new photo success rate or end-to-end speed claim. Production only reorders two existing rejection gates; no extra pass, larger budget or relaxed criterion is introduced.
change: Check the existing bend-radius/sharp-turn predicate before full geometry validation; every accepted edit still passes geometry and paper checks.

renderingDiagnosis.conclusion: Explicit cancellation of exact duplicate fill curves leaves all PNG bytes identical. Remaining seams in these two exports are not an antialiasing artifact from already-shared cuts.
renderingDiagnosis.visualReview: Reviewed original and extra-aligned 400-pixel gingerbread/Viking renders. Several interior seams disappear; uneven contours, small edge nicks and some frame seams remain.

limitations: Floating-point chord-based intersection checks, not exact algebraic predicates.
Samples on a target cut within twice the geometry tolerance have no unambiguous colour and are counted separately.
Forward image sampling supplements the edge-parity and path-topology checks; it is not an exact area comparison.
Cut-error simulation and paper-core analysis are separate from this nominal validator.

paper.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.

frozenMatrix.scope: Both compared runtimes are uninstrumented, each in a fresh serial process. Twelve sharing rounds, no wall-time cutoff; timing excludes independent export rendering and validation. The earlier instrumented baseline matrix is preserved separately.

limitations: The two named examples were chosen after seeing visible seams. The fixed 47-export matrix broadens the comparison but is still a development set.
Under a live deadline, doing less wasted work can change which valid candidate is reached. Identical unlimited-pass geometries do not establish identical fresh-solve outcomes.
Pixel-centre versus independent antialiased rendering can differ slightly after an extra alignment. This experiment does not add an extra pass to production.
No changes to cropping, material classification, annotation or neural training.
